title: The translated Schur rows stay below the displayed Gaussian bound (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, every off-diagonal row sum of the Schur complement on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` is strictly below `exp(-2 a theta)+5 exp(-2 a)`, which equals `exp(-9 pi/722)+5 exp(-18 pi)` at these parameters.
- Vertices 0 and 9 do not meet the interior, so their Schur rows are the original rows. The other four rows are strictly below `24/25`. The filled entry from vertex 2 to vertex 7 lies strictly between `3/10` and `2/5`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one Schur section, not the all-size row-gap claim.
